meaning: reports/release.json production_status and release_ready only say the route passed Synth's router and DRC gates. They are not review sign-off.

routing_and_drc.evidence: DRC: 0 unconnected pads, 0 errors on kicad-cli pcb drc.

erc_dispositioned.evidence: 1 ERC warning (supply identity). Non-blocking. See reports/rtd_front_end.erc.json.

analog_review.evidence: LM358 non-inverting gain stage (gain=11x), RC low-pass filter (fc~160Hz). No independent analog expert review. Class-B scope (ADS124S08, REF5025, RP2350, 4-wire RTD) not implemented - parts not available in registry. Current design is simplified 2-layer LM358 divider board.

class_b_scope.evidence: Parent Class-B requirement calls for ADS124S08, REF5025, RP2350, 4-wire RTD, AGND/DGND single-point tie. These parts are not in the Synth registry. Current implementation is a simplified 2-layer board. Either implement full Class-B board or split as separate example.
